milestone: Exact lower, upper or paired inner rim fillets on canonical circular cylindrical through-bores, including eccentric parallel axes

oracle.operation: OCCT Boolean Cut of independent cylinders, followed by BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet on the selected original inner cap rim edges
oracle.checked: BRepCheck validity, one solid, face count, cap and wall circle centers and radii, analytic toroid centers and radii, signed volume and area

native: Byte-stable replay and exact full-chart, two-owner edge, cap disk and rational tangency proofs for all three modes

display.checks: Closed oriented meshes preserve native vertices in all three modes. The paired mode has no intersections under the complete exact BVH check and refuses too few triangles atomically.

negative: Exact outer tangency, exterior crossing, touching axial blend bands, insufficient work, cancellation, and a changed upper meridian with unchanged rim curves and periodic seam
compatibility: Six baseline native digests, one existing successful sharp diagonal 256-triangle display digest, and the other five preexisting display-budget results matched; see legacy-baseline.sha256 and legacy-candidate.sha256.
